name: I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 3,000 m long and 45 m wide

max_aircraft.v: critical aircraft is the Airbus A380-800 (aerodrome code 4E)

hours.v: airport closed for Nyepi (Balinese Day of Silence): in 2026 from 06:00 local on 19 March to 06:00 local on 20 March (all domestic and international flights stopped); the date changes each year, check the NOTAM
hours.quote: akan dihentikan sementara mulai Kamis, 19 Maret 2026 pukul 06.00 WITA hingga Jumat, 20 Maret 2026 pukul 06.00 WITA.

slots.v: a slot is a main requirement for a flight approval; slots for non-scheduled flights are managed by the airport operator and the air navigation provider (AirNav), not the scheduled-flight slot office (country-wide statement, 1 Oct 2025; Bali is not named)
slots.quote: termasuk slot untuk penerbangan tidak berjadwal, dikelola oleh pengelola bandar udara dan pengelola pelayanan navigasi ... Slot yang telah diberikan kepada maskapai menjadi salah satu syarat utama dalam pengajuan persetujuan penerbangan

permits.v: foreign non-scheduled commercial and non-commercial flights need a Flight Approval, applied for at least 3 working days before the flight (issued within 3 working days of a complete application); the file includes the operator's AOC or OC, registration, airworthiness, pilot licences, third-party liability insurance, manifest, charter contract, slot recommendation, and diplomatic and security clearance (country-wide)
permits.quote: Pemohon mengajukan permohonan Persetujuan Terbang (Flight Approval) paling lambat 3 (tiga) hari kerja ... Rekomendasi alokasi ketersediaan waktu terbang (slot time) dari pengelola slot di Indonesia; ... Telah memiliki Izin Diplomatik (Diplomatic Clearance) dan Izin Keamanan (Security Clearance).
